description: Email the GYOTAK referrer a link to the form where they register where their commission should be sent: a Thai PromptPay QR (read inside the form, the image is never uploaded) or a stablecoin address (USDC on Base, or USDM on Cardano). Call this when the user wants to register, see, or change their payout destination. Returns the destination currently on file, masked, and the masked address the link was sent to. For security the form URL is never shown in the chat — the link goes only to the email address on file, so tell the user to open it from their email. Never ask the user to type the number or the wallet address into the chat.

customerKey.description: Your customerKey (gyotak_cus_...). Omit when connected through a personal token URL.
